# nodes / access-log

<!-- Generated by @virtbase/proxmox-api-generator. Do not edit. -->

2 operations.

### <span class="method-badge" data-method="GET">GET</span> `/nodes/{node}/access-log`

```ts
proxmox.nodes.$(node)["access-log"].$get()
```

Read a page of the API access log of pveproxy and spiceproxy, including its rotated copies, newest requests first. A page ends once enough requests matched or after reading 512 MiB of log data, also without any match, and the next page continues at its 'next-cursor'. The values of query parameters are redacted for all but root@pam.

Returns `object`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `node` | string | yes | The cluster node name. — format `pve-node` |

::: details 14 optional parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `after` | string |  | Only the requests logged after this position, the 'head-cursor' of an earlier page, to follow the log. Cannot be combined with 'cursor'. — ≤ 128 chars |
| `auth-id` | string |  | Only requests whose user or API token contains this text, ignoring case, so a user also matches its own API tokens. — ≤ 1024 chars |
| `auth-id-exact` | boolean |  | Whether 'auth-id' only matches itself as a whole, so a user does not match its API tokens, and '-' matches requests without any. |
| `client` | string |  | Only requests from this client address. — format `ip` |
| `cursor` | string |  | Continue with the requests logged before this position, the 'next-cursor' of the previous page. — ≤ 128 chars |
| `limit` | number |  | The maximum number of requests to return. — min 1, max 1000, default `500` |
| `max-status` | number |  | Only responses with a known HTTP status code of at most this value. — min 100, max 999 |
| `method` | string |  | Only requests with this HTTP method. — ≤ 32 chars |
| `min-status` | number |  | Only responses with a known HTTP status code of at least this value. — min 100, max 999 |
| `path` | string |  | Only requests whose path contains this text. — ≤ 1024 chars |
| `path-group` | string |  | Only requests whose path falls into this group, as the statistics list them. — ≤ 1024 chars |
| `search` | string |  | Only requests whose client address, user or path contains this text, ignoring case. — ≤ 1024 chars |
| `since` | number |  | Only requests logged at or after this UNIX epoch. — min 0, max 253402300799 |
| `until` | number |  | Only requests logged at or before this UNIX epoch. — min 0, max 253402300799 |

### <span class="method-badge" data-method="GET">GET</span> `/nodes/{node}/access-log/stats`

```ts
proxmox.nodes.$(node)["access-log"].stats.$get()
```

Count the requests of the API access log of pveproxy and spiceproxy, including its rotated copies, in a time range, which defaults to the last day. As the log is not ordered by time, the counting reads through the files like a page of the access log does, as much as one page at most, and tells which parts of the files it covered.

Returns `object`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `node` | string | yes | The cluster node name. — format `pve-node` |
